help.selecteerHoofdstuk: Select a chapter to get started

eigenaar.voornaam: Your first name as shown on official documents.
eigenaar.tussenvoegsel: E.g., 'van', 'de'. Common in Dutch names but optional.
eigenaar.achternaam: Your last name as shown on official documents.
eigenaar.geboortedatum: Required for legal documents and inheritance tax calculations.
eigenaar.bsn: Your Citizen Service Number is stored encrypted and required for notarial deeds.
eigenaar.adres: Your residential address is used for official correspondence and documents.
eigenaar.postcode: Dutch postal codes consist of 4 digits and 2 letters (e.g., 1234 AB).
eigenaar.woonplaats: The municipality where you are registered.
eigenaar.telefoon: Optional – can be displayed on your emergency card for next of kin.
eigenaar.email: Will not be shared and serves only for your own records.
eigenaar.burgerlijkeStaat: Affects statutory inheritance rights and division of joint property.
eigenaar.huwelijksvoorwaarden: Determines how assets are divided upon death or divorce.
eigenaar.datumHuwelijk: The date of your marriage or registered partnership.
eigenaar.legitimatieSoort: The type of identification document you have.
eigenaar.documentnummer: The number on your ID – required for notarial deeds.
eigenaar.geldigTot: Important: an expired ID can cause problems with notarial matters.

notaris.naam: The full name of your notary, including any title (esq.).
notaris.kantoor: The name of the notary office where your will was drafted.
notaris.telefoon: Direct phone number for quick accessibility by next of kin.
notaris.email: Email address for correspondence about your file.
notaris.adres: Useful for next of kin who need to visit the office.

erfgenamen.voornaam: The official first name of the heir as on their ID.
erfgenamen.achternaam: The official last name – important for legal documents.
erfgenamen.tussenvoegsel: Middle name particles such as 'van', 'de' or 'van der'.
erfgenamen.relatie: The family relationship determines the inheritance tax bracket.
erfgenamen.telefoon: Phone number for contact during estate settlement.
erfgenamen.email: Email address for sending documents and emergency codes.
erfgenamen.geboortedatum: Required for determining legitimate portion and tax exemption.
erfgenamen.bsn: Stored encrypted – required for notarial deeds and tax returns.
erfgenamen.adres: The residential address is needed for official correspondence.
erfgenamen.legitimatie: Type of identification document of the heir.
erfgenamen.documentnummer: The ID document number – required for notarial deeds.
erfgenamen.bestemming: What specific assets or percentages this heir receives.

shamir.wachtwoord: Your Lumio master password is split into multiple shares.
shamir.drempel: The minimum number of heirs required to work together for access. A higher threshold is more secure but requires more coordination.

boedel.bezitCategorie: Categorize your assets for a clear distribution overview.
boedel.omschrijving: A clear description helps heirs with identification.
boedel.geschatteWaarde: An estimate is sufficient – exact valuation can be done later by heirs.
boedel.locatie: Where is this asset located? Helpful for heirs during settlement.
boedel.bestemdeErfgenaam: Who should receive this specific asset? (Optional)
boedel.vermogensSoort: Private property stays separate; joint property is divided.
boedel.kadastraalNummer: The cadastral number can be found on the deed or via kadaster.nl.
boedel.kenteken: The vehicle's license plate – found on the registration certificate.
boedel.kvkNummer: Only fill in if this asset is linked to a business.
boedel.ibanRekening: Your full IBAN number. Always starts with NL for Dutch accounts.
boedel.saldoRekening: An estimate of the current balance – does not need to be exact.
boedel.verzekeraar: The name of the insurance company.
boedel.polisnummer: Found on your policy or in your insurer's app.
boedel.verzekerdBedrag: The maximum amount that will be paid out.
boedel.begunstigde: Who receives the payout? This may differ from legal heirs.
boedel.schuldeiser: The party to whom you owe money.
boedel.referentie: Your contract number or reference with the creditor.

digitaalBezit.platformNaam: The name of the service or website (e.g., Google, Facebook, LinkedIn).
digitaalBezit.categorie: Categorize accounts for overview: social media, email, banking, etc.
digitaalBezit.gebruikersnaam: The username or email you use to log in.
digitaalBezit.accountEmail: The email address linked to this account.
digitaalBezit.url: The direct link to your account page or the login page.
digitaalBezit.gewensteActie: What should next of kin do? Delete, memorialize, or transfer.
digitaalBezit.overdrachtAan: If you choose transfer: to whom should the account be transferred?
digitaalBezit.wachtwoordNaam: A descriptive name so you can find the password later.
digitaalBezit.wachtwoord: Passwords are encrypted with AES-256-GCM – only visible after unlocking.
digitaalBezit.walletNaam: A recognizable name for this wallet.
digitaalBezit.cryptoType: The type of cryptocurrency: Bitcoin, Ethereum, etc.
digitaalBezit.walletAdres: The public wallet address – can be safely shared.
digitaalBezit.exchange: The exchange where you trade (e.g., Coinbase, Binance, Bitvavo).
digitaalBezit.seedPhrase: WARNING: Your seed phrase gives full access to your crypto. Stored encrypted.

testament.typeTestament: The type of will: notarial, codicil, or holographic.
testament.datumTestament: The date your will was drafted or last modified.
testament.ctrNummer: The number in the Central Will Registry – your notary can provide this.
testament.locatieTestament: Where is the physical will kept? (Notary, safe, home)
testament.uitsluitingsclausule: Protects inheritances from the (ex-)partners' assets of your heirs.
testament.legaten: Specific assets or amounts you want to bequeath to certain people.
testament.begunstigdeNaam: The name of the person or organization you want to benefit.
testament.begunstigdePercentage: The percentage of the estate this beneficiary receives.
testament.executeurNaam: The person you appoint to settle your estate.
testament.executeurRelatie: The relationship with the executor – e.g., lawyer, partner, child.

uitvaart.uitvaartType: Your preference: burial, cremation, or natural burial.
uitvaart.budget: A budget indication: simple, average, or extensive.
uitvaart.uitvaartondernemer: If you have already chosen a director, note the details here.
uitvaart.kleding: What clothing do you want to wear? Or specific wishes for the coffin.
uitvaart.heeftVerzekering: Have you taken out funeral insurance?
uitvaart.ceremonieSoort: The type of ceremony: religious, humanist, personal, or other.
uitvaart.ceremonieLocatie: Where should the ceremony take place?
uitvaart.muziekwensen: What music do you want played during the ceremony?
uitvaart.bloemen: Preferences for flowers or rather donations to a charity?
uitvaart.sprekers: Who do you want as speakers during the ceremony?
uitvaart.rouwkaarttekst: A text or quote for the mourning card.
uitvaart.rouwadvertentie: Do you want an obituary and if so, in which newspaper?
uitvaart.condoleance: Where and when the condolence will take place.
uitvaart.aula: The hall where the funeral should take place.

euthanasie.wilEuthanasie: Whether you want euthanasia in case of hopeless suffering.
euthanasie.datumOndertekening: The date you signed your advance directive.
euthanasie.situatiebeschrijving: Describe in which situation you would want euthanasia.
euthanasie.huisartsNaam: The name of your GP who knows your medical situation.
euthanasie.praktijk: The name of the GP practice.
euthanasie.vertegenwoordigerNaam: The person who may decide on your behalf if you can no longer do so.
euthanasie.dementieclausule: A specific clause for the case of advanced dementia.

donor.donorkeuze: Your choice: donate, not donate, or limited donation.
donor.geregistreerd: Whether you are officially registered with the Donor Registry.
donor.referentie: Your registration number with the Donor Registry (if known).

noodcontacten.naam: The full name of the emergency contact.
noodcontacten.relatie: Your relationship with this person (partner, child, friend).
noodcontacten.rol: The functional role: trusted person, GP, notary, etc.
noodcontacten.telefoon: A direct phone number for emergencies.
noodcontacten.email: Email address for less urgent communication.
noodcontacten.instructies: Specific instructions for next of kin when contacting this person.
noodcontacten.isGedeeld: Mark as shared if this contact is also relevant for your partner.

documenten.naam: A descriptive name so you can find the document later.
documenten.categorie: Categorize: will, ID, insurance policy, etc.
documenten.verloopdatum: Set an expiration date for documents that need renewal.

erfgenamen.beschrijving: Heirs are the people who will receive your estate. Add at least one heir to arrange the transfer of your assets.

bezittingen.beschrijving: Register your assets such as real estate, vehicles, and valuables so heirs know what exists.

rekeningen.beschrijving: Add your bank accounts so next of kin know which accounts need to be closed or transferred.

verzekeringen.beschrijving: Register your insurance policies so heirs know which policies need to be claimed or cancelled.

schulden.beschrijving: Add any debts and loans for a complete financial overview.

accounts.beschrijving: Add your online accounts (social media, email, subscriptions) so next of kin know what to do.

wachtwoorden.beschrijving: Store important passwords encrypted. These are only accessible after being unlocked by your heirs.

crypto.beschrijving: Register your cryptocurrency wallets. Without access to your wallets, crypto can be lost forever.

documenten.beschrijving: Upload important documents like your will, ID, or insurance policies in one secure place.

begunstigden.beschrijving: Add the people or organizations you want to benefit in your will.

executeurs.beschrijving: An executor settles your estate. Appoint someone you trust.

snapshots.beschrijving: Create a snapshot of your current wishes to track history.

details.beschrijving: Record your funeral wishes so next of kin know what you want.

genodigden.beschrijving: Add the people you want at your funeral.

noodcontacten.beschrijving: Emergency contacts are the first points of contact for next of kin. Think of your GP, notary, or a trusted person.

zoekresultaten.beschrijving: Try a different search term or adjust your filters.

auditLog.beschrijving: No activities have been recorded in your account yet.
